name: vike-data-api
description: Crypto data for AI agents: on-chain wallets and tokens, Hyperliquid, HL Cohorts and Polymarket.

interface.longDescription:
Vike gives ChatGPT live crypto data through one remote MCP server. Each user signs in to their own Vike account with OAuth.

On-chain: labelled wallets and tokens on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Base and HyperEVM, with flows and balances, PnL history, counterparties, first funder, exchange usage, entity labels and risk flags, token holders, transfers and a token screener.

Hyperliquid: wallet positions and fills, liquidations, leaderboards, builders, market stats and candles, plus HL Cohorts, the hourly long/short positioning of each perp split by wallet size and PnL cohort.

Polymarket: markets, order books, trade tape, settlements, wallet profiles, leaderboard and smart-money flows.

All times are UTC. Docs: https://vike.io/docs/ai/data/
defaultPrompt: Are whales long or short BTC on Hyperliquid right now?
Where did Polymarket smart money flow in the last 24 hours?
Who are the top holders of PEPE on Ethereum?

positive.prompt: Are whales long or short BTC on Hyperliquid right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the latest hourly long/short bias for BTC split by account-size cohort and says whether the largest wallets lean long or short.

positive.prompt: What has wallet 0x28C6c06298d514Db089934071355E5743bf21d60 been doing on Ethereum this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the wallet's volume, inflow, outflow and net flow over recent windows on Ethereum.

positive.prompt: Who are the top holders of PEPE on Ethereum, and what are they labelled?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves PEPE to its contract, then lists the largest holders with their balances and entity labels where known.

positive.prompt: Where did Polymarket smart money flow in the last 24 hours?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the markets with the largest net inflow from the smart-money cohort over the last 24 hours.

positive.prompt: Show the top Hyperliquid traders by 30-day PnL.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a ranked list of Hyperliquid wallets by 30-day realized PnL with their key stats.

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the ocean.
What will the weather be in Paris tomorrow?
Help me fix a syntax error in my Python script.
